title: “They are uncultured”: Unveiling Covert Harms and Social Threats in LLM Generated Conversations
reasoning: The paper introduces and utilizes the CHAST (Covert Harms and Social Threats) framework to evaluate social biases and identity threats (specifically race and caste) in LLM-generated dialogue. While the framework includes a 'Morality Threat' metric, this evaluates the social disparagement of a group's moral standing as a form of intergroup harm, rather than benchmarking religious faith, spiritual doctrines, or formal ethical reasoning.
